sentences.text: Petitioner is the father of the victim child who was aged 17 years 5 months and 16 days.
It is contended that the victim child suffers from multiple disabilities.
She suffers 90% blindness in both eyes and 75% intellectual disability.
Petitioner's daughter is a victim of sexual assault.

The First Information Report was registered on 3 April, 2024 with Vishrambag Police Station, Sangli for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(j), 376(2)(l) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 4, 5 and 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act,
2012 (POSCO Act).

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. The First Information Report was registered against unknown persons.
However, the investigation revealed that the victim was subjected to sexual assault by her brother who was minor aged 15 years and 9 months.

3. Learned Advocate for the Petitioners submitted that the Petitioner has made an Application on 8 th April, 2020 to the Government Medical College and Hospital Miraj for medical termination of unwanted pregnancy and the Medical Board gave an opinion on 12 April 2020 that victim was pregnant for 26 weeks and 2 days and the pregnancy being over 24 weeks and therefore appropriate directions ought to be obtained from the Court.

entities.text: Government Medical College and Hospital Miraj
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. The victim is pregnant of 28 weeks.

The report annexed to the Petition though indicates that the permission should be sought from the Court, it does not specify that the victim was examined and whether the pregnancy of the victim could be terminated.

5. In view of the aforesaid circumstances, we direct the concerned Medical Board constituted under the Medical Vinaa Khadpe 2 of 3 903-wp-5673-2024.doc Termination of Pregnancy Act, 1971 to examine the victim and submit the report to this court as to whether the pregnancy of the victim can be terminated.

6. Stand over to 18th April, 2024.
 (N. R. BORKAR, J.) (PRAKASH D. NAIK, J.)
